title: Institution
description: PROVISIONAL (pending founder WhatsApp handoff, 2026-08-12). An educational institution as a first-class structure: a college, university, or school whose real-world organization (programmes, hostels, cohorts) jt adopts rather than reinvents.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this record's schema (semver: major.minor.patch).

name.description: Full official name of the institution.

shortName.description: Common short name or abbreviation students actually use.

kind.description: What sort of institution this is (college, university, school, institute). Free string for now; may become an enum once the handoff settles the vocabulary.

affiliatedTo.description: The affiliating university, if this is an affiliated college (common in India).

location.description: Where the institution is, at city/state/country granularity.

academicYearStartMonth.description: Month (1-12) the academic year usually starts; most Indian colleges start in July or August.
